title: Index of the cached source texts (artifacts/<product>/knowledge/sources/index.json, beside sources/S<n>.txt), written only by knowledge.mjs snapshot (D-051). Quotes in the knowledge files are checked against these texts.

status.description: fresh: cached by this entry's run; stale: a later fetch failed, the older text is kept; failed: the script's fetch failed and there is no text.

captured_by.description: script: fetched with a plain GET or read from the repo; agent: the agent's capture (--from-file), only for a live-product source or after the script's own fetch failed in that run.

runId.description: The run that cached the text. A later run fetches the source again.

from.description: The capture file, for captured_by: agent.

fetchError.description: The script's last failed fetch of this source.
